items.i1: Save words with the sentences you met

q1.question: How does Wordmet help me learn vocabulary?
q1.answer: Wordmet helps you save words with the sentences you read, practice using them in context, and review them on a schedule. Words you often get wrong come back sooner.

q2.question: Is Wordmet free?
q2.answer: Yes. Saving words, flashcards, automatic reviews, and basic exercises are free, with no time limit. You can try AI exercises for 14 days or choose the Pro plan.

q3.question: How is Wordmet different from other English learning apps?
q3.answer: Wordmet turns your saved sentences into fill-in-the-blank exercises, so you don't have to create each card yourself. Words you often get wrong come back sooner.

q4.question: Are my saved sentences shared with others?
q4.answer: No. Wordmet doesn't share your saved sentences with other people or add them to the shared sentence bank.
